settings.venueNameEN: Church of the Nativity of the Lord
settings.whishTextEN: YOUR WARM WISHES AND COMPANY ON OUR WEDDING DAY IS THE MOST PRECIOUS GIFT OF ALL. HOWEVER, IF YOU WISH, A WEDDING REGISTRY IS SET AT WHISH MONEY ACCOUNT
settings.whishTextAR: حُضُورُكُمْ وَمَحَبَّتُكُمْ يَوْمَ زَفَافِنَا هُمَا أَثْمَنُ هَدِيَّةٍ عَلَى الإِطْلاقِ. وَلِمَنْ يَرْغَبُ، تَتَوَفَّرُ لائِحَةُ الهَدَايَا عَبْرَ حِسَابِ WHISH MONEY:
settings.verseEN:
“SO THEY ARE NO LONGER TWO, BUT ONE FLESH,
THEREFORE WHAT GOD HAS JOINED TOGETHER
LET NO ONE SEPARATE”
settings.verseAR:
«إِذًا لَيْسَا بَعْدُ اثْنَيْنِ بَلْ جَسَدٌ وَاحِدٌ.
فَالَّذِي جَمَعَهُ اللهُ لاَ يُفَرِّقْهُ إِنْسَانٌ»
settings.whishSubtitleEN:
FOR THE HONOR OF YOUR PRESENCE
